$comment: ★ MSVC'S SIZED INTEGER SUFFIXES (P68 round 13, D-C-MSVC-SIZED-INTEGER-SUFFIXES-REFUSED). `i8` `i16` `i32` `i64` and `ui8` … `ui64`, the `i` and the `u` each in either case (24 spellings), FIX the literal's type — `i8` plain char, `ui8` unsigned char, `i16` short, `ui16` unsigned short, `i32` int, `ui32` unsigned int, `i64` long long, `ui64` unsigned long long — and a magnitude that type cannot hold is reduced modulo 2^width at the type's signedness. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-25 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc --legs windows-x86_64-release` (MSVC 19.51.36260): all 24 compile with no diagnostic at /W4 under /std:c11, /std:c17 and /std:clatest, `300i8` is 44, `256ui8` is 0, `4294967296i32` is 0, `0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFi64` is -1 and `-128i8` the int +128, in `#if` too (both of MSVC's preprocessors); gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 refuse all 24 ('invalid suffix'). Under `DSS = (gcc ∪ clang ∪ MSVC) ∪ ISO C` one accepting reference makes the spellings REQUIRED and MSVC is the only witness of their meaning; DSS refused every one with P_MalformedNumber before. `i8` is plain `char`, so its values are checked against `(char)` of the magnitude and its `#if` sign against `'\x80'` — the same file is right on a signed-char and an unsigned-char target. What each exit code proves: 1-24 every spelling at 5, by `_Generic` type and by value against a `volatile`; 25-28 `i8` reduced as a plain char, including `-128i8` reduced BEFORE the minus; 29-37 every other width at and past its range edge; 38-41 an enumerator, an array bound, a case label and an `i64` past 32 bits. The `#if` blocks and the `_Static_assert`s pin phase 4 and the constant-expression folder. ★ RED-ON-DISABLE (each measured through `dssharness test`, P68 round 13): drop `UI16` from the language document and this file does not compile (P_MalformedNumber '5UI16'); type `i8` as `signed char` and check 1 fails where plain char is signed while the `#if` char pin fires where it is unsigned; drop the reduction's sign extension and the pin 'a signed sized literal read unsigned in #if' fires; read every fixed type SIGNED in phase 4 and 'an unsigned sized literal read signed in #if' fires. The `release` arm pins the same file through the shipped release pipeline.
